system.specialAbility:
You become Trained in Acrobatics and Performance, and you become Trained in a relevant Lore of your choice.

Example Lores include Dance Traditions Lore, Court Festivals Lore, Theater Lore.
system.description: You performed with movement, learning to keep your footing while making difficult steps look effortless. You came to recognize a room's mood before the first measure had ended.
